row.evidence: AWS Wickr's API reference describes the user scimId field as "used for identity synchronization. Currently not used."; SSO is OIDC-only and users are invited or created through the console, CSV or the AWS Wickr API.
row.notes: Status unchanged from June (none). No SCIM endpoint is documented in the AWS Wickr Administration Guide or API Reference; the User object carries a scimId field that the API reference says is 'Currently not used'. SSO (Standard and Premium) is OpenID Connect only; the docs say SAML providers are not supported, so June's 'OIDC/SAML, Active Directory sync via ADFS' is corrected (the What-is page only says Wickr 'integrates with ... Active Directory (AD)' with no AD sync procedure documented). Automation is through the AWS Wickr admin API (AWS SigV4, region endpoints admin.wickr.<region>.amazonaws.com): BatchCreateUser, UpdateUser, BatchToggleUserSuspendStatus, BatchDeleteUser, ListUsers, security groups; available to any network (no plan gate stated). Pricing: AWS price list shows Standard $5 and Premium $15 (June said Premium up to $25; corrected from the price list); billed monthly per user on a prorated basis, no annual option. Wickr Enterprise (self-hosted) is Contact us. Okta and Microsoft Entra SSO are set up as custom OIDC app registrations per AWS guides; no provisioning.

limitations.text: The User object has a scimId field, but the API reference says it is currently not used; no SCIM endpoint is documented.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint documented anywhere in the admin guide TOC or API reference.

methods: aws_sigv4 (IAM access keys via AWS SDK/CLI/REST)

BatchDeleteUser: permanently delete users and their data

audit_log_api.notes: Admin API calls are recorded in AWS CloudTrail (c27); no Wickr audit-log API for in-app events is documented.

limitations.text: A user can only be assigned to a single security group.

okta.notes: AWS links an Okta OIDC SSO setup guide; okta.com/integrations/wickr, /aws-wickr and /amazon-wickr return 404, so no OIN listing was found.

entra.notes: Set up as a custom App Registration (OIDC), not a gallery app; Microsoft Learn search for 'wickr' returned no gallery tutorial.

fallbacks.other_sync: AWS Wickr admin API (BatchCreateUser etc.) via AWS SDK/CLI; What-is page mentions Active Directory integration without a documented sync procedure.

citations.title: BatchCreateUser
citations.quote: Creates multiple users in a specified Wickr network. This operation allows you to provision multiple user accounts simultaneously, optionally specifying security groups, and validation requirements for each user.

citations.title: BatchDeleteUser
citations.quote: Deletes multiple users from a specified Wickr network. This operation permanently removes user accounts and their associated data from the network.

citations.title: BatchToggleUserSuspendStatus
citations.quote: Suspends or unsuspends multiple users in a Wickr network. Suspended users cannot access the network until they are unsuspended.

citations.title: ListUsers
citations.quote: Retrieves a paginated list of users in a specified Wickr network. You can filter and sort the results based on various criteria such as name, status, or security group membership.

citations.title: GetUser
citations.quote: Retrieves detailed information about a specific user in a Wickr network, including their profile, status, and activity history.

citations.title: UpdateUser
citations.quote: Updates the properties of an existing user in a Wickr network. This operation allows you to modify the user's name, password, security group membership, and invite code settings.

citations.title: CreateSecurityGroup
citations.quote: Creates a new security group in a Wickr network. Security groups allow you to organize users and control their permissions, features, and security settings.

citations.title: ListSecurityGroups
citations.quote: GET /networks/ networkId /security-groups?maxResults= maxResults

citations.title: ListSecurityGroupUsers

citations.title: BatchReinviteUser
citations.quote: Resends invitation codes to multiple users who have pending invitations in a Wickr network.
